00aa3280.name: BSP_GuiManager_FindCameraStore
00aa3280.evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet gui_render_order, read-only analysis. __thiscall(ECX = manager, const descriptor*), RET 4, returns the store or 0. Walks the multimap at manager+8h and returns the first store whose descriptor matches: +00h as an integer and +04h, +08h, +0Ch and +14h as floats. +10h, the Priority copy, is deliberately not compared, so two layers differing only in Priority share one camera, scene and draw pass. Logs cGuiManager:Re-use camera store 0x%x/%s. Sole caller 00AC59A0.
